title: Hematite Spherules (Blueberries)
quickFact: Small gray spheres discovered in 2004 that proved liquid water once flowed through Martian rocks.
explore: In 2004, NASA Opportunity discovered millions of tiny, ball-bearing-sized spherical stones dotting Meridiani Planum. Nicknamed 'blueberries', these concretions are composed of hematite (Fe2O3) and could only have formed when mineral-laden groundwater slowly seeped through porous bedrock billions of years ago.

refinementConversion.description: High-purity iron extraction for base electrical conductors.

checkQuestion.question: What geological condition is required to form hematite spherules?
options: Liquid water percolating through sedimentary rock
checkQuestion.explanation: Hematite blueberries are concretions created by precipitation of iron minerals from groundwater flowing through porous rock.
